mapper.sql: m.id, m.code, m.name, m.category_id, c.code AS category_code, c.name AS category_name, p.name AS parent_category_name, m.material_type, m.stock_unit, m.purchase_unit, m.conversion_factor, m.width_cm, m.weight_gsm, m.composition, m.default_supplier_id, s.short_name AS default_supplier_name, m.supplier_item_no, m.ref_price, m.status, (SELECT count(*) FROM bas_material_sku k WHERE k.material_id = m.id) AS sku_count, m.update_time
FROM bas_material m JOIN bas_material_category c ON c.id = m.category_id LEFT JOIN bas_material_category p ON p.id = c.parent_id LEFT JOIN sup_supplier s ON s.id = m.default_supplier_id

choose.otherwise: AND (m.code ILIKE '%' || #{q.keyword} || '%' OR m.name ILIKE '%' || #{q.keyword} || '%' OR m.supplier_item_no ILIKE '%' || #{q.keyword} || '%' OR m.composition ILIKE '%' || #{q.keyword} || '%')

mapper.select:
SELECT m.id, m.code, m.name, m.supplier_item_no, s.short_name AS default_supplier_name, CASE WHEN m.category_id = #{categoryId} AND lower(m.name) = lower(#{name}) false THEN '同分类同名' ELSE '同供应商同货号' END AS reason FROM bas_material m LEFT JOIN sup_supplier s ON s.id = m.default_supplier_id WHERE (false
OR (m.category_id = #{categoryId} AND lower(m.name) = lower(#{name}))
OR (m.default_supplier_id = #{supplierId} AND upper(m.supplier_item_no) = upper(#{itemNo}))
) AND m.id <> #{excludeId} ORDER BY m.code LIMIT 10

SELECT k.id AS sku_id, k.code AS sku_code, m.id AS material_id, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.material_type, m.category_id, c.name AS category_name, k.color_id, cl.code AS color_code, cl.name AS color_name, cl.hex AS color_hex, k.spec, m.stock_unit, m.purchase_unit, m.conversion_factor, COALESCE(k.price, m.ref_price) AS price FROM bas_material_sku k JOIN bas_material m ON m.id = k.material_id JOIN bas_material_category c ON c.id = m.category_id LEFT JOIN bas_color cl ON cl.id = k.color_id WHERE k.status = 1 AND m.status = 1
AND (k.code ILIKE '%' || #{q.keyword} || '%' OR m.name ILIKE '%' || #{q.keyword} || '%' OR m.supplier_item_no ILIKE '%' || #{q.keyword} || '%' OR cl.name ILIKE '%' || #{q.keyword} || '%')
AND (m.category_id = #{q.categoryId} OR c.parent_id = #{q.categoryId}) ORDER BY m.code, k.code
SELECT id, code, name, short_name FROM sup_supplier WHERE code IN #{code}
SELECT id, code, name, short_name FROM sup_supplier WHERE id IN #{id}
